hg 1/144 strike freedom gundam seed free.name: HG 1/144 Strike Freedom Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO Ver. (Tentative)
hg 1/144 strike freedom gundam seed free.summary: Strike Freedom as seen in SEED FREEDOM ZERO, with SEED Action System, two beam rifles and gradient beam saber effects. Bandai-sourced reports say Jan 2027; Gundam Planet lists a Feb 2027 arrival, which is likely just a shipping estimate.

hg 1/144 infinite justice gundam & boost.name: HG 1/144 Infinite Justice Gundam & Booster Unit (Tentative)
hg 1/144 infinite justice gundam & boost.summary: New HG kit from SEED FREEDOM ZERO with newly tooled weapons and a booster unit, announced by Bandai Hobby per Toy People. I didn't find a price.

hg 1/144 gouf ignited custom (seed freed.name: HG 1/144 GOUF Ignited Custom (SEED FREEDOM ZERO)
hg 1/144 gouf ignited custom (seed freed.summary: Heavier-armored Gouf Ignited variant that reuses some parts from the Heine Westenfluss kit and adds new forearms, shoulders, lower legs, head crest and flight pack. Gundam Planet lists a May 2027 arrival, which is likely a shipping estimate.

hg 1/144 gundam zero (mobile suit gundam.name: HG 1/144 Gundam ZERO (Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO)
hg 1/144 gundam zero (mobile suit gundam.summary: Lead mobile suit of the RG XARX-ZERO anime. It is the first Gunpla with six-color multi-injection molding and a linked-spine articulation system. Gundam Planet lists a May 2027 arrival, which is likely a shipping estimate.

hg 1/144 gundam helix (gundam trajectory.name: HG 1/144 Gundam Helix (GUNDAM TRAJECTORY OF THE OTHER RAIL / ROGUE ORBIT)
hg 1/144 gundam helix (gundam trajectory.summary: Protagonist suit of the RG Project action game, with a large sword and rifle that mount on the backpack. HLJ lists 2027/01/31 at a different yen price (2,500), so I used the Bandai-sourced figure. The Earth Blue Ver. is a game-bundle exclusive and is not covered here.

hg 1/144 calice (gundam trajectory of th.name: HG 1/144 Calice (GUNDAM TRAJECTORY OF THE OTHER RAIL / ROGUE ORBIT)
hg 1/144 calice (gundam trajectory of th.summary: Knight-themed suit that carries a massive lance, from the RG Project game. Bandai Hobby has published its product page. Gundam Planet lists a March 2027 arrival, which is likely a shipping estimate.

hg 1/144 bau bahlam (gundam trajectory o.name: HG 1/144 Bau Bahlam (GUNDAM TRAJECTORY OF THE OTHER RAIL / ROGUE ORBIT)
hg 1/144 bau bahlam (gundam trajectory o.summary: Heavily armored pirate mobile suit piloted by Big Paul, with a giant chainsaw. Bandai Hobby has published its product page. Gundam Planet lists a March 2027 arrival, which is likely a shipping estimate.

rg star gaogaigar.name: RG Star GaoGaiGar
rg star gaogaigar.summary: Space-combat version of RG GaoGaiGar. It adds newly tooled Stealth Gao II, Ul-Tech Engines and removable Phantom Rings, and includes four machines. Bandai Hobby listed it with a date and price after showing the prototype earlier this month.
